question.text: Debt-oriented assets purchased post April 1, 2023 are generally taxed at:

answer.text: Slab rate (no LTCG/STCG distinction for specified debt MFs)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Post-April 2023, specified debt schemes taxed at slab rate regardless of holding period. **The Trap:** Older LTCG@20%+indexation no longer applies to these. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in X-B. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Set expectations — debt MF LTCG tax benefit has been reduced significantly.
